fix_copyright_file: fix the copyright lines in a file by replacing them with updated git author data
get_authors_from_git: get the list of authors and commit dates for a file from its git history
generate_new_copyright_lines: generate new copyright lines from git history and previous author names
list_text_files_in_repo: list all text files tracked by git in the repository
run_copyright_fix_all: run the copyright fix on all text files in the git repository
